subject: Request: Microgrant batch for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar attendees
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@inferenz.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Microgrant request for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar — 150 attendee vouchers

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we loved the demo you ran at the community call last month. Inference Labs is hosting a two-hour hands-on webinar (May 18) for developers evaluating hosted inference runtimes. We expect ~150 signups; of those, ~90 are active engineers.

Would Redwood be open to providing a small microgrant (promo credit) we can distribute to attendees so they can try Redwood Hosted with real workloads? Request: 150 one-time vouchers, each preloaded with $50 of credits (usable within 30 days). The attribution will be: "Inference Labs x Redwood — Developer Trial" and we’ll include Redwood logo on the registration and a brief CTA during the session.

Attaching the event deck and a short preview of registrants for context. We can sign a simple MSA addendum or PO if needed.

Let me know next steps and any internal approvals required.

Thanks,
Elena
Events Lead, Inference Labs
[Attachment: InferenceLabs_EventDeck.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)]
[Attachment: attendee_preview.csv (CSV, 45KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Microgrant request for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar — 150 attendee vouchers

Folks — forwarding an ask from Inference Labs. Quick summary: they want 150 x $50 trial vouchers for an educational webinar on May 18. They’re asking for a simple MSA addendum or PO.

My take: great visibility in the developer community, but 150 x $50 is material and we should cap or get marketing/partnership credit approval. Marissa — does this fit our partner promo budget? Monica — what’s the fastest ops route for generating single-use voucher codes and TTL?

If we can’t do 150, proposing 100 vouchers (developers-first cohort) with a promo window of 45 days. Please reply with final yes/no and any required paperwork.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Developer Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Forwarded attachments retained: InferenceLabs_EventDeck.pdf, attendee_preview.csv]

Cc: 
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Microgrant request for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar — 150 attendee vouchers

Thanks for the ping, Jonas — happy to support but need to tighten the ask. 150 x $50 = $7,500 list; we should aim for smaller footprint with better attribution. Proposed approach:

- Approve up to 100 vouchers at $50 each (total $5,000) from Partnerships budget.
- Vouchers to be single-use, valid for 45 days, restricted to Hosted inference (no dedicated/private consumption).
- Require Inference Labs to include a Redwood-branded 2-slide callout during the webinar and share a post-event usage report (unique codes redeemed, top 5 org domains).

Monica — can Ops/Promo generate 100 single-use codes with those constraints and a TTL? Also need a HubSpot deal or PO to attach for accounting (I can cover from Partnerships if finance needs a code).

Jonas — if you agree, I’ll mark as approved and loop Finance if they require a formal PO.

—Marissa
Senior Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Microgrant request for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar — 150 attendee vouchers

All — Ops can generate 100 single-use voucher codes with 45-day TTL and restriction to the Hosted API product. I’ll need:

1) Final approved count (confirm 100).
2) HubSpot deal id or PO to link the cost (you provided DL-2027-0321; please confirm).
3) A short legal note if they require an MSA addendum — we can route to Legal but it will add ~3–5 business days. For a quick turnaround I recommend asking them to accept our standard partner promo terms (I’ll attach).

Once I get (1) and (2) I’ll generate codes and provide a CSV (code, value, expiry, usage flag). I’ll also scope whether codes can be single-use per email to reduce sharing.

Attaching the standard partner promo terms for reference.

–Monica
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Promo_Terms_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@inferenz.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Microgrant request for 'Hands-on Inference' webinar — 150 attendee vouchers

Elena — good news. We can approve a batch of 100 single-use developer vouchers valued at $50 each (valid for 45 days) under the Partners promo program. Next steps:

- Please confirm acceptance of Redwood’s standard partner promo terms (see attached in my reply) or sign a short MSA addendum if you prefer an executed PO; signature will add a few business days.
- Confirm billing reference: we have deal id DL-2027-0321 (I’ll add it to hubspot). If you need a PO, send that to ops@redwoodinference.com and cc me.
- Monica will generate the 100 codes and provide a CSV mapping codes → expiry. We’ll also send a post-event redemption report (unique domains, redemption rate).

If that works, we’ll aim to have codes to you by Thursday (May 6) so you can include them in the attendee welcome email.

Thanks for coordinating — excited to support the session.

Best,
Jonas Weber
